title: CONNECT-IP Foundation Policy Architecture
purpose: Define RFC 9484 CONNECT-IP mechanism scope, QUIC variable-length integer use, and stream-reference interpretation.
design_summary: `Http3ConnectIpFoundationPolicy` rejects IP header-field conveyance and non-IP protocol tunneling, delegates variable-length integer parsing/formatting to the HTTP/3 QUIC varint helper, accepts non-minimal encodings through that parser, and maps stream references to the whole connection when the HTTP version does not multiplex streams.
data_and_state_considerations: The helper is stateless and does not own packet forwarding or tunnel assignment state.
edge_cases_and_constraints: Minimal encodings remain valid even though non-minimal encodings are accepted.
The foundation scope does not define URI Template or capsule behavior.
risks: Later CONNECT-IP slices still need URI Template, request, capsule, route, and datagram policy coverage.
